g.text: CODE-TRACED CONNECTIONS • DATA ROUTES • PERMISSIONS • MODEL HANDOFFS
Two independent interfaces share one inference gateway
speech input → native agent → speech output
ComfyUI is started only for rendering
restricted mode replaces normal effectful tool permissions
Role selection happens through the same serial gateway. No parallel model swarm.
Plan inspects. Build changes require approval. Operations target the copied project.
Text models unload before rendering; ComfyUI stops afterward.
Retrieval and browser traffic uses the configured VPN path; no direct host fallback in those routes.
Vault import becomes PLAINTEXT in project
WebUI and OpenCode own separate tool loops.
Both submit model requests to one gateway.
The engine serialises heavyweight model jobs.
Paths show implemented source code, not proof of
successful operation on the owner's Mac.
Browser VPN exits, approvals and resource use
Dotted grey = control/admission (not a tool execution route)
Repo code ≠ owner-Mac acceptance • Schematic routes, not measured network traces
